People: William Shakespeare (author, Wikidata Q692), died 1616; Christoph Martin Wieland (translator, Wikidata Q154010), died 1813. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Shakespeare, William, 1564-1616; Wieland, Christoph Martin, 1733-1813 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Shakespear Theatralische Werke. 2, 1763, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/11919989bsb. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 78%, 41%, 60% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of William Shakespeare, Christoph Martin Wieland, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
